bills_repeat_day_monthly.name: bills_repeat_day_monthly
bills_repeat_day_monthly.value: ("bills"."repeat_unit" is not distinct from 'month') = ("bills"."repeat_day" is not null)

bills_amount_varies_monthly.name: bills_amount_varies_monthly
bills_amount_varies_monthly.value: not "bills"."amount_varies" or ("bills"."repeat_unit" is not distinct from 'month' and "bills"."next_amount_minor" is null)

bills_repeat_until_valid.name: bills_repeat_until_valid
bills_repeat_until_valid.value: "bills"."repeat_until" is null or ("bills"."repeat_unit" is not null and "bills"."due" is not null and "bills"."repeat_until" >= "bills"."due")

bills_amount_unknown_shape.name: bills_amount_unknown_shape
bills_amount_unknown_shape.value: "bills"."amount_minor" is not null or (("bills"."repeat_unit" is null or "bills"."amount_varies") and "bills"."next_amount_minor" is null and "bills"."previous_amount_minor" is null)

bills_due_unknown_one_off.name: bills_due_unknown_one_off
bills_due_unknown_one_off.value: "bills"."due" is not null or ("bills"."repeat_unit" is null and "bills"."series_bill_id" is null and "bills"."cancel_by" is null)

households_ai_endpoint_together.name: households_ai_endpoint_together
households_ai_endpoint_together.value: ("households"."ai_provider" is null and "households"."ai_protocol" is null and "households"."ai_base_url" is null) or ("households"."ai_provider" is not null and "households"."ai_protocol" is not null and "households"."ai_base_url" is not null)
